pairs.why: Both are nearly the same render, but A's red body has softer, broader highlights and a calmer lens glow, closer to the gently polished finish of the real lamp and bugle than B's slightly harder, statue-like gloss.
Almost identical, but A's shading is slightly softer and more even, which matches the real cards a little better; B's rim and body speculars are a touch harsher.
Barely different; A's body reads slightly smoother and less lacquered, closer to the real cards' moderate gloss.
The two drawings are effectively the same in shape, color, light and finish, so neither is clearly closer to the real cards.
Nearly identical, but A's red is a little lighter and softer-lit, like the real cards; B's body is slightly darker and higher-contrast.
Same object, same construction and finish, and no difference large enough to pick one.
A's softer beam and gentler body highlights sit slightly closer to the real cards' warm, smooth rendering than B's crisper chrome and glossier body.
